To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

the novel linker peptide PT 7 can be used to construct anti- CD16 ScFv and the anti- CD16 scFv antibody with PT 7 linker peptide possesses similar binding activity to Daud cells with the anti-CD16 scFv with common PT5 linker peptide.

the anti-CD16 single-chain antibody with novel linker peptide PT5 (Glu(3)Gly(3)Glu(3)) was successfully constructed and its binding activity to Daudicells was higher than that of anti-CD 16 single-chain antibody (ScFv) with the common linker peptide (Ser(4)Gly(4)) in the same expression system.
the novel linker peptide PT5 (i.e. (Gly(3)Ser)(3)) is better than PT7 in the construction of anti-CD6 ScFv antibody.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the effect of different linker peptides on the expression level and stability of ScFv antibody.
the design, expression, purification, assembly and activity of anti-CD-16 ScFv antibodies.
the design of novel linker peptides and molecular modeling of anti-body.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
the linker peptide PT7 could be used to construct the anti-CD16 scFv antibody.

the linker peptides with different length and amino acid sequence have a different effect on the properties of anti-CD 16 ScFv, and the linker peptides with the length of 15 amino acid residues (PT5) and 18 amino acid residues ( PT7 ) are suitable for the expression of anti-CD-16 ScFv and the anti-CD16-ScFv with the linker peptides PT5 and PT7 possess similar ability to bind with Daudi cells.

PT5 linker peptide was more suitable for the construction of anti-CD 16 antibody than PT7 linker peptide, and the molecular modeling method was useful to predict the structure-function relationship and combining ability of anti-CD antibodies with different linker peptide.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
the molecular modeling of anti-body with the two different linkers is feasible and the novel linker peptide PT 7 can improve the expression level of anti-CD 16 ScFv.
the molecular modeling and molecular dynamic simulation of anti-CD 16 ScFv antibodies with different linkers were successfully performed.
the novel linker peptide (G3S3) was designed to construct anti- CD16 ScFv and the molecular modeling of antiCD16 antibody with two different linkers was designed and predicted.
The main takeaway from our work is that
the linker peptide PT5 (G4S3) and PT7 (G3S3A3) have similar binding activity to Fc gamma RIII.
the molecular graphic technique can provide useful insights into the design and assembly of anti-Fc gamma RIII antibody.
the linker peptide is not the main reason why anti-CD16 scFv antibody with common linker peptide has poor expressing level and stability.
